ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form wide, contiguous bands along the trailing edges and outer margins. Numerous discrete, low-intensity circular blobs are distributed within the white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present across the entire visible trailing edge. Distal tips exhibit high-amplitude, jagged pixel variations and irregular bulbous extensions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges toward the submerged median notch; convex sweep along the lateral margins terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular dark-pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes, with a high-contrast concentration of ~15 discrete clusters on the image-left lobe and ~12 on the image-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal low-intensity pixel disruptions observed on the lower-left portion of the image-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue morphology and bulbous calcification/encrustation at both distal tips, disrupting the expected smooth linear boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive large dark ring-shaped pixel cluster located in the mid-ventral region of the image-right lobe.
